ogImage.heading: A tech community for developers and companies
ogImage.tagline: Share your profile · Find talent · Land a real opportunity

hero.title: Stop sending CVs into the void
hero.subtitle: TechToJob is a community of developers and tech companies. It's not a portal where you disappear among hundreds of applications: here you take part, people get to know you and opportunities come from what you do, not from what you put in a form.

howItWorks.title: From your first message to a real opportunity
howItWorks.subtitle: No endless forms, no algorithms silently rejecting you. You take part, you become visible and opportunities come out of it.

steps.title: Join and introduce yourself
steps.text: Hop into the Discord, explore the channels by stack and tell people who you talk to. No forms, no queues.

steps.title: Take part
steps.text: Answer questions, share what you build, sign up for a tournament. The more you participate, the better the community knows you.

steps.title: Opportunities show up
steps.text: Companies that already know how you work reach out directly. You don't fill in a form and pray: you decide whether it fits.

talent.title: Create your profile and let them find you
talent.subtitle: A real person reads your profile, not an algorithm that rules you out before knowing you. You don't need to be senior: junior, mid or transitioning, there's room for you here. And it's free.

card.name: Marta · Frontend
card.quote: "My profile spoke for me before the interview. They already knew what I could do, and the conversation went straight to the point."

companies.title: Publish your role and meet people before hiring
companies.subtitle: Here you see people working before you look at their CV. Tournaments, contributions and conversations give you more context than any cover letter.

benefits.title: Publish what you need
benefits.text: A clear requirement reaches people who already know how to move in the community, not saturated inboxes.

benefits.title: Access real profiles
benefits.text: Every profile shows stack, level and availability backed by their participation in the community.

benefits.title: Get to know them by what they do
benefits.text: Tournaments, contributions and conversations tell you more than a CV. You know who you're talking to before the first interview.

tournaments.title: Compete, learn and put a face to your code
tournaments.subtitle: Real challenges, timed deliveries and judges with public criteria. They help you learn, give you something to talk about in an interview and let the community know who you are. This website came out of one.

card.label: Tournament #2 · TechToJob landing
card.title: Build a real landing page
card.text: Design, build and deploy the community's front door. SEO, design and real code. What you build here gets used and seen.
card.button: Sign me up for the tournament

prizes.text: Visibility among the community and companies
Something real to show at an interview

networking.title: Finding out early beats a perfect CV
networking.subtitle: Channels by area with industry people who answer questions in minutes and share openings that never hit a job board. Good jobs aren't found: you hear about them.

messages.author: Lucía
messages.text: Someone in the channel tipped me off about a role that was never posted on LinkedIn. I got it.

messages.author: Diego
messages.text: The other day someone asked about their stack and I ended up recommending them for a project. Knowing people here opens doors a CV can't.

items.title: How to prepare for a frontend technical interview
items.summary: Logic, your own project and how to tell what you know without underselling yourself. A guide born from the community's experience.

newsletter.title: The best of the week, in your inbox
newsletter.subtitle: One email every Monday with open tournaments, openings shared by the community and things you won't find on LinkedIn. Once a week, no spam, unsubscribe whenever you want.

closing.title: You know what it is. The difference is joining
closing.subtitle: Junior, senior or transitioning: you come in, you take part and the opportunities come out of it. There's no form to fill in, just people waiting for you.

sections.title: Who manages the data
sections.text: TechToJob is a community run by its founders and collaborators. This page explains clearly how the personal data of anyone taking part in the community or using this site is handled.

sections.title: What data we collect and why

items.label: Community profile:
items.text: name, stack, level and availability that you publish yourself so companies can find you.

items.label: Newsletter email:
items.text: only to send you the weekly updates. You can unsubscribe at any time.

items.label: Site usage data:
items.text: anonymous statistics (page views, device) processed in aggregate form.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can access, rectify, delete and object to the processing of your data, as well as withdraw your consent at any time. Write to us from the community channel and we'll handle it as soon as possible.

sections.title: Identification
sections.text: This website belongs to the TechToJob community, a collaborative project that connects developers and tech companies.

sections.title: Use of content
sections.text: The content of this site (texts, design, logos and illustrations) belongs to TechToJob or its authors. It may be shared with attribution, but commercial use without prior authorization is not permitted.

sections.title: External Discord links
sections.text: When you join the Discord server from this site you move to a third-party service with its own terms and privacy policy. TechToJob is not responsible for those external spaces.

sections.title: What cookies are
sections.text: Cookies are small files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site work and help us understand how it's used.

sections.title: Cookies we use

paragraphs.label: Technical:
paragraphs.text: essential for the website to work properly.

paragraphs.label: Analytics:
paragraphs.text: aggregated, anonymous information about site usage, only when you opt in.

sections.note: This site does not use advertising cookies.

sections.title: How to manage them
sections.text: You can accept, reject or configure non-essential cookies from the banner shown on entry, or from your browser settings, where you can also delete them at any time.
